body:
# Matthiesen Lib Webhooks
A Server-side library mod for Matthiesen Lib projects that want to be able to send discord webhooks easily! ## Requirements - [Matthiesen Lib API](https://modrinth.com/mod/matthiesen-lib-api/) ## Docs Documentation for this mod can be found at [mods.matthiesen.dev](https://mods.matthiesen.dev/matthiesen-lib-webhooks/) ## Library Usage ```java MatthiesenLibWebhooks.Webhooks webhooks = new MatthiesenLibWebhooks.Webhooks("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."); webhooks.sendMessage(message -> message .withUsername("My Mod") .withContent("Simple webhook message")); webhooks.sendMessage(message -> message .withUsername("My Mod") .addEmbed(embed -> embed .withTitle("Status Update") .withDescription("Everything is online") .addField("Players", "12", true) .addField("TPS", "20.0", true) )); ``` ## Version Compatibility | Minecraft Version | Mod Version | |-------------------|-------------| | 1.21.1 | 1.x.x | ## License MIT - see `LICENSE`.
